gaps.sentence: The witness claims ___ the getaway car parked outside for an hour.
gaps.explanation: 'Claims to have seen' — the perfect infinitive marks an earlier action.

gaps.sentence: She avoided ___ about the incident for weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Avoid' is always followed by the -ing form.
can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the deadline despite the strike.
She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).

gaps.sentence: The teacher made us ___ the whole essay again.
gaps.explanation: 'Make someone do' — active 'make' takes the bare infinitive.
